feature: automatic durable term and votedFor persistence

behavior.startup: configured replicas restore metadata automatically when present
behavior.term_transition: election timeout persists incremented term and self-vote before action emission
behavior.vote_transition: vote grants persist votedFor before grant is returned
behavior.failure: required persistence failure moves the state machine to STOPPED and returns an error
behavior.storage: 0600 temporary file, fsync, atomic rename, SHA-256 checksum

limitations: The metadata file is local; replicated term/vote persistence over the gRPC transport remains pending.
The test validates reboot-equivalent process restoration, not sudden power-loss behavior on every filesystem or storage device.
Production deployments must place metadata on a durable, access-controlled filesystem and include it in backup and recovery policy.
